title: fleet-guards: WARN path has no dedup and files no bd issue — persistent helper failure is log-only
description: Codereview of 2ehk (edge pass, kimi-k3). Every other guard in fleet-guards.sh files a bd issue behind a flag-file dedup (stall canary L80-86, waste alarm L106-112, pause expiry L59-66). The new WARN branches (L97-100) only echo every cycle. If fleet_burn.py is deleted or crashes persistently, the result is one log line per 10 min forever — no bd issue, no rate limit. Fix: flag-file dedup (e.g. .fleet-waste-helper) + bd create on first failure, clear the flag on first clean parse. P3 because the log line does print (fail-loud exists), but the escalation policy should match the other guards for unattended operation.
close_reason: Fixed: new waste_helper_alarm() in fleet-guards.sh escalates helper failure to the queue once per failure episode — flag-file .fleet-waste-helper + bd create (P1 bug, message names the blindness and the $STATE/fleet_burn.err evidence path) on first empty/unparseable output; flag cleared on first clean parse (both evaluated:true and legit evaluated:false paths) so a later episode re-alarms. Verified with the real script block under a stubbed bd on PATH: 2 consecutive failure cycles -> exactly 1 bd create; clean parse clears flag; new episode -> 2nd create. bash -n clean.
